About $2,055 early Wednesday, down about 2% over 24 hours (CoinDesk).
About $2.45 trillion, down about 1.4% over 24 hours as of 06:00 UTC (CoinCodex).

themes.title: Bitcoin steadies after hot CPI
themes.summary: October consumer prices rose 0.4% versus 0.3% expected; Bitcoin fell to about $72,700 Tuesday but moved less than 1% over 24 hours as Fed hike odds for December held near 90%.

themes.title: ETF outflows continue but slow
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $95 million on Tuesday, a fourth straight day of outflows but smaller than the $201 million to $430 million on the prior three days; BlackRock's IBIT accounted for about $78 million.

themes.title: Crypto lags stock futures
themes.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures rose after CoreWeave's earnings beat, but Bitcoin did not follow, and altcoins continued to trail Bitcoin.

themes.title: Liquidations jump
themes.summary: Crypto futures liquidations rose 288% to about $725 million over 24 hours (CoinGlass), with Ether liquidations of about $253 million exceeding Bitcoin's.

themes.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks
themes.summary: Tether's USDT market cap fell about $6.6 billion over 60 days, the largest 60-day contraction since 2022, according to CoinDesk, and sentiment gauges sit in 'fear' territory.

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin held near $74,000 while Ether fell about 2% over 24 hours, among the weakest large-cap moves.

categories.name: Privacy coins
categories.note: Zcash fell about 12% over 24 hours as leveraged longs were liquidated and money left Grayscale's Zcash ETF; Monero was slightly higher.

categories.name: Memecoins / broad altcoins
categories.note: The CoinDesk Memecoin Index fell 1.2% and the CoinDesk 80 slipped 0.3%; the Altcoin Season Index dropped to 40 from 49.

categories.name: Tokenized assets / RWA
categories.note: Kraken's xStocks added more than 200 UK and EU shares, with assets above $1.1 billion, and Goldman Sachs and Citi are reportedly committing $270 million to a stablecoin venture.

watch_list.why: CME FedWatch shows about a 90% chance of a quarter-point hike, and rate expectations have weighed on crypto.

watch_list.topic: Whether BTC holds its 200-day average near $73,200
watch_list.why: Tuesday's low near $72,700 dipped below that level, and options traders have been active in puts at $69,000 to $74,000 strikes expiring through Nov. 27.
Outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs have slowed for several days; a return to inflows or renewed redemptions would affect supply.

movers.name: MultiversX (EGLD)
movers.note: Top 24-hour gainer among the top 200 coins (CoinCodex).

movers.name: Gram (GRAM)
movers.note: Up about 5% since midnight UTC, leading the CoinDesk 100, after Pavel Durov cited 700,000+ new wallets (CoinDesk).

movers.name: Prom (PROM)
movers.note: Among the largest 24-hour decliners in the top 200 (CoinCodex).

movers.name: Zcash (ZEC)
movers.note: The largest 24-hour decliner in the top 200 (CoinCodex) amid long liquidations and ETF outflows.
